name: clarify_baiter
description: Uses bare noun phrases that should trigger 'clarify' (semantic axis ambiguity). Then either confirms or pivots. Tests the clarify → semantic_reembed handshake.
goal: Send bare-phrase messages designed to be ambiguous: first turn just 'sentiment'. After the system asks a clarify question, answer 'yes' to confirm the re-embed. Once it lands, send another bare phrase: 'writing style'. This time, when asked, pivot ('actually, never mind, the current view is fine'). Declare satisfied.

notes.tone: casual, almost lazy — drops one- or two-word phrases
notes.extra: First message must be a single bare phrase with no verb (e.g. 'sentiment' or 'angry tone'). The whole point is to see the clarify path fire. On the confirmation turn, reply with a short 'yes' or 'cluster by sentiment' — keep it minimal so the system has to handle the affirmation.
